description: Defines a model class 'CandidateAttachmentModel' for representing candidate attachment data within the OrangeHRM recruitment module. Implements serialization and normalization using traits, and maps properties from the RecruitmentAttachment DTO to a schema used in API responses.

classes.name: CandidateAttachmentModel
classes.description: A model class that serializes candidate attachment data for API responses, utilizing traits for normalization and mapping properties from a DTO.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a RecruitmentAttachment DTO, setting up filters and attribute mappings for serialization.
